item: A redirect hop is robots-checked again when its scheme, host or path changes, and the first-run preflight's homepage ping obeys robots.txt (R636)
summary: R636 (Plan, 03:54Z, on R629's stated gaps: "Robots is re-checked, fail-closed, on any redirect hop whose robots key (scheme+host) or path changes. That covers a same-host hop to a new path and an http→https upgrade. The preflight homepage ping checks robots.txt too, with no stated exception. If robots disallows the ping or can't be fetched, the ping is skipped and reported in fixed words."). BEFORE, measured on 17576d851 over an in-memory session: R629's _take_hop_host returned early for a hop on the same host key (the host and port, no scheme), so https://a.example/x answering 302 Location /private was followed under "Disallow: /private" (requests: robots.txt, /x, /private); http://a.example/x answering 301 to https://a.example/x was followed with the https robots.txt disallowing everything, and again with it answering 500, and that robots.txt was never read (requests: the http robots.txt, /x, the https /x); a query-only hop /page?a=1 to /page?private=1 went through "Disallow: /page?private". The first-run preflight's homepage ping (src/monitoring/preflight.py) was requested after its own robots read had found disallowed, blocked (403) or http_500, and its hop from / to /en/ was followed under "Disallow: /en/". NOW (line numbers on the merged head): _take_hop_host's same-host branch (src/ingest/__init__.py:2015) calls _recheck_hop_robots (:2028) when the fetcher respects robots. It compares the hop with the address that answered by _robots_target (:2044: the robots key, scheme and host key, and the request target robots rules match, path plus ;params plus query; the fragment is never sent) and, when they differ, runs _enforce_robots(hop=True), fail-closed: RobotsDisallowed, or RobotsUnavailable with its cause, cached and backed off as a first read, the sentence ending "(reached by a redirect)" as R629's does and the address through failure_url. Another path or query on the same key is answered by the cached robots.txt (no new read); an upgrade (or a downgrade) reads the other scheme's robots.txt, under the lock the chain already holds. Same-host hops keep that lock and wait no second interval: the interval rule is per host and unchanged; the kill-switch reads stay where R629 placed them. A hop to another host is unchanged (R629: switch, lock handover, robots, interval, switch). _guarded_redirect_get gains hop_robots (:1837), passed by the homepage ping alone (:1971): each hop it will request (never one past the bound) is checked the same way, with no lock taken and no interval waited, as the ping takes none. Robots reads pass no chain and no hop_robots (the fetcher's _get_robots, and both preflights' own reads: preflight.py's robots read and feed_preflight.py's _check_host_robots), so a read never recurses. The ping (src/monitoring/preflight.py:148) is made only when the preflight's own read found allowed (can_fetch of the homepage) or missing (404/410); otherwise it is not requested, reachable is None (not established, never "unreachable") and homepage_skipped holds fixed words: "homepage not requested: robots.txt disallows it" for a disallow, "homepage not requested: robots.txt could not be read" for blocked (401/403), any other status and an unreachable read. A hop the ping's robots check refuses (:159) is recorded as reachable True (the homepage answered with a redirect, a 3xx, which the ping already counts as reachable) and homepage_skipped "homepage redirect not followed: robots.txt disallows the address it leads to" or "homepage redirect not followed: the robots.txt of the address it leads to could not be read"; a refusal met while the switch is engaged is skipped_offline, the preflight's rule for any check. Verdicts are unchanged in every case (robots_denied for disallowed or blocked, unreachable for other unreadable reads, ok otherwise). MERGE: built on 17576d851, then local/r629 (4c82331cc: the fold of R629's two security reads, bbd48d04b, and a row edit) merged in with no conflict. The fold's empty-path rule in _enforce_robots (an empty path checked as "/") applies to R636's re-check, so a same-host hop from /x to https://a.example?x under "Allow: /x, Disallow: /" is refused as /?x (pinned; it fails on R636 alone and on the fold alone). _robots_target adds no empty-path rule of its own: it reads "?x" and "/?x" as two targets, which costs one more cached check, never a missed one. The fold's hop_url on a hop's CrawlDelayDeferred is another host's (a same-host hop waits nothing), and its retry move after attempt += 1 leaves the retry's hop re-checked from the cache. DECISIONS: a query-only change counts as a path change: Python's RobotFileParser matches the path and the query together ("Disallow: /page?private" refuses /page?private=1 and allows /page?a=1), and so are ;params; it costs no read, since the robots key is unchanged and the cached robots.txt answers. A hop whose robots key and target are both unchanged (only the fragment differs) is not checked again. The ping's homepage is judged by the preflight's own read just before it (the same URL, the same user agent, no second request); its hops by the fetcher's _enforce_robots and cache, the one a scrape uses (persisted to the robots sidecar). COSTS, stated: an http to https upgrade reads the https robots.txt once per host per TTL, also when the http robots.txt itself 301s to the https one (the cache files a read under the key asked for); a ping whose homepage redirects reads robots.txt through the fetcher once more on a cold cache (the read is persisted, and the scrape after the preflight would read it anyway); a ping refused at a hop records no homepage_status. TESTS: tests/test_redirect_robots_recheck_r636.py, 67, through the real EthicalFetcher, ingest_url, crawl_source and the preflight's _check_one, _check_host_robots and preflight_sources, over an in-memory session (every planted URL routed, so a follow is seen), a fake clock, every fetch in a bounded thread; the switch control on a real requests.Session over an in-memory adapter. 50 fail on 4c82331cc (49 of the first 66 on 17576d851) and the 17 controls pass on both (an allowed same-host hop followed; a same-target hop not checked again; an allowed new-path, upgrade or query-only hop waiting no second interval or Crawl-delay; an upgrade not waiting a Crawl-delay only its https robots.txt declares; the hop past the bound reading nothing; a fetcher that reads no robots reading none; another host's hop reading its robots.txt once and waiting its interval; a robots read's own same-host hop not checked; a Stop as the first host answers refusing an upgrade before its robots read on a real session; the ping made when robots allows the homepage or is missing, four cases; feed_preflight's robots read following its hop with no robots read there). Three tests in tests/test_redirect_hop_robots_r629.py pinned the old behaviour (a same-host hop to a disallowed path followed; an upgrade reading no https robots.txt; the ping reading no robots.txt for the host it is redirected to) and now state R636's; they fail on 4c82331cc, the other 78 of the merged file's 81 pass there, all 81 on head. RELATED: 226 related test files (every file mentioning redirect, robots, crawl, sitemap, preflight, politeness or rate limit, R629's rule, the new file among them): on 58099bdb7 (R636 alone) 8,002 passed, 12 skipped, 4 failed; on 09c8225c8 (the merged head's code) 8,029 passed, 12 skipped, 4 failed. Each of the 4 fails the same way on 17576d851, the four R629 reported (tests/test_csv_feeds.py::test_feeds_api_list_and_import, KeyError 'count'; tests/test_workflow_integration.py::test_full_investigative_workflow; tests/test_shared_file_writes.py::test_no_new_unlocked_write_site_and_no_stale_allowance, the same three unlocked write sites in src/ingest/__init__.py, 426, 558 and 722, on base and head; tests/test_xdist_file_placement.py::test_a_real_run_announces_the_fixed_placement, pytest-xdist not installed here). ruff F,B,I clean on the touched files; ruff ratchet 412; mypy clean on src/ingest/__init__.py and src/monitoring/preflight.py. Mutants, in a detached worktree at 4c82331cc with head's sources (removed after), all 29 killed (28 also on 17576d851 before the merge): no same-host re-check; the re-check ignoring respect_robots; the hop compared with itself; a second interval on a same-host hop (killed only by the Crawl-delay-only-on-https control: inside one chain the host's stamp is written when the chain ends, so a second wait owes nothing otherwise); the held lock taken again (hangs); another host's hop checked twice; the comparison dropped; the target without the query, without the params, or with the fragment; the key without the scheme; the robots.txt of the address left read instead; the "(reached by a redirect)" words dropped; a forced re-read; the loop ignoring hop_robots; the ping's hop checked past the bound; robots reads recursing; the ping passing no hop_robots; the ping made whatever robots says, skipped on a disallow only, or made on a 5xx robots.txt; a skipped ping recorded as unreachable; one skip sentence for every cause; skip words carrying the state and the URL; a refused ping hop filed as a homepage error, as not reachable, or with its words swapped; a refused ping hop read before the switch; the re-check calling can_fetch itself, bypassing _enforce_robots. NOT CHANGED, stated: the chain's interval is the first request's, read from the first address's robots.txt, so an upgrade hop does not wait a longer Crawl-delay declared only in the https robots.txt (it governs the next request asked for over https); the ping's hops take no host lock and wait no interval, as the ping never did; preflight's robots_denied verdict still holds a 401/403 beside a Disallow (the open queue item on it is untouched). Release-notes line: «A redirect to another page on the same site, or from http to https, is now followed only when the site's robots.txt allows the page it leads to, and the first check of each source no longer opens a homepage its robots.txt disallows or that cannot be read. (R636)»
